Finalizes the eMudhra runtime-trust remediation. No application code changes
and no migration — pull the new image and recreate the container.

## What changed

- Base image moves to the now-published `node:22.23.4-alpine`, which carries
  the corrected CA bundle, and the temporary `NODE_OPTIONS=--use-openssl-ca`
  workaround is removed — both stages verify TLS against Node's bundled roots
  again, with Alpine's fixed `ca-certificates` still installed fresh at build
  time as defense in depth.
- Local toolchain pin already resolved Node `22.23.4` (no change).

## Upgrading

Pull the new image and recreate the container. If you run the frontend from a
local checkout rather than the image, run `mise install` to confirm Node
`22.23.4`.
